requirements.note: Relevant science/computing bachelor or related master, suitable coursework and research. Statement explains graduate-study reasons, research, interdisciplinary approach and track; faculty identification helpful. GRE concerns may be discussed with program director.

english.note: Central Most Other Programs row; PTE53; confirm IB minima. Exemption: two full-time academic years excluding ESL/test prep at English-language institution in US/listed countries; overseas English instruction alone insufficient.

applicationFee.note: UMass Boston alumni/current students completing degree before graduate enrollment exempt; no citizenship restriction stated, international applicability confirm. Codes before payment; no refunds.

funding.note: Department-assigned assistantships not guaranteed. AY2026–27 full TA/RA/AA appointment:18hours/week,40weeks,25865USD,100%tuition waiver, partial health subsidy. Appointment rate, not program-wide/Fall2027 offer.
